We introduce LVAS-Agent, a multi-agent collaborative framework for end-to-end long video audio synthesis. Built on VLM and LLM-based agents, it simulates real-world dubbing workflows, enabling automatic video script generation, audio design, and high-quality audio synthesis for long videos.
outputs: structured video scripts, audio design documents, and synthesized sound effects for long videos
